# JutJut

> JutJut is an Australian student-platform rollout for genuine skill-verification requests, live employer job listings, course-linked practicals and business offers.

## Current service boundaries

- **Controlled rollout** — visitors can register interest. A waitlist entry is not an account and does not require account-verification through a link.
- **My Kit** — students can request a verification from someone who knows their work. A request remains pending until that person responds; JutJut does not locally manufacture a verified item.
- **Jobs Board** — only live employer-posted listings should be shown. Recording an application does not guarantee an interview, job offer or employer response.
- **JutJut Practicals** — course-required placements, projects and cohort briefs. Institutions define pathways and retain final authority over course qualification.
- **The Drop** — business offers with listing-specific availability, capacity and redemption conditions. There is no promise of weekly offers or a fixed Monday release schedule.
- **YourWay** — local display preferences such as reduced motion and plain-language job descriptions where provided. JutJut does not currently submit a profile, application or academic document to a university.
- **Payments** — employer credit purchase checkout, automatic rebilling and provider refunds are paused until payment settlement and reconciliation are independently verified.

## Data and privacy boundaries

Contact-sharing preferences are recorded with a job application. Full self-service account deletion and university integrations are not currently available and are not presented as completed features.

## Indexing

Public marketing content is crawlable. Authenticated product views, dashboards and account pages are not intended for search indexing.
